privacy.pageDescription: Learn how Todaha protects your privacy and handles your personal data.
privacy.heroSubtitle: Your privacy and data security are our top priorities. Learn how we protect and handle your information.
privacy.introContent: At Todaha, we are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your data when you use our AI assistant services.
privacy.dataCollectionContent:
We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, use our services, or contact us for support.

We also automatically collect certain information about your device and how you interact with our services, including usage patterns and performance data.

We may collect information from third-party sources to enhance our services and provide better customer support.
privacy.dataProtectionContent:
We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

All data transmission is encrypted using SSL/TLS protocols, and we maintain strict access controls to ensure only authorized personnel can access your information.

We regularly review and update our security practices to maintain the highest level of protection.
privacy.dataUsageContent:
We use your information to provide, maintain, and improve our AI assistant services, including personalizing your experience and providing customer support.

We may use your data to communicate with you about our services, send important notifications, and respond to your inquiries.

We analyze usage patterns to improve our services and develop new features that better serve our users.
privacy.dataRetentionContent:
We retain your personal information only for as long as necessary to provide our services and fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy.

When you delete your account, we will delete your personal information within 30 days, except where we are required to retain certain information for legal or regulatory purposes.

You have the right to request deletion of your personal information at any time by contacting our support team.
